floorPlans.introduction: Compare Grace and Pearl three- and four-bedroom townhouses. The full sheets include both floors, key plans and the site layout.
floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a Greenridge townhouse design and layout
floorPlans.note: On the Grace TH03 sheet, the metric terrace figure contains an extra decimal point. The displayed square-foot areas follow the original imperial table. Confirm the signed unit plan and plot position.

review.images: Reviewed the official gallery and wide hero. Removed the narrower repeat of the hero elevation. The wide street view supplies the card. Interior selections show the living area and bedroom.
review.location: Matched Greenridge’s exact point and reviewed physical brochure page 4. The original regional map and five driving times are included. The map marks Emaar South at community level.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all 11 physical pages and all eight original two-storey drawings, with TH01 to TH04 in both Grace and Pearl. Checked each label, key plan and area panel visually and cross-checked all imperial totals against the independent extraction. Greenridge Grace TH03 on physical page 5 prints 6..94 in the metric terrace column. The original drawing is preserved.

unavailable: Signed plot-specific areas and exact plot entrances were not verified.
